headline: Discussed HB1300 school tax cap, town budget process, capital projects, and shared purchasing; no decisions recorded.
summary: Officials discussed HB1300 and HB1331, the town's tax cap and budget timeline, capital improvement plans, and joint purchasing. The minutes list no decisions on these topics. The only recorded votes were to recess and adjourn.
